هَضْبٌ A kind, mode, or way. A. Heyth quotes the following verse of El-Kumeyt, describing a horse: “مُخَيَّفٌ بَعْضُهُ وَرْدٌ وَسَائِرُهُ
جَوْنٌ أَفَانِينُ إِجْرِيَّاهُ لَا هَضْبُ
” The poet means, that his running, or usual running, was of different, or various, kinds; not of one هضب, or kind. (L.) ＝
-A2- See هَضْبَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
